System-call wrappers for exit_group, nanosleep, login user lookup, and user-to-UID/GID mapping.

# Purpose
This header file declares system utility functions for process control, sleep, and user lookup. It includes `fd_sys_util_exit_group()`, which ends the calling process by using the `exit_group(2)` system call and does not return, and `fd_sys_util_nanosleep()`, which sleeps for a requested time and resumes sleep after interruption. It also declares `fd_sys_util_login_user()`, which returns the current logged-in user name, and `fd_sys_util_user_to_uid()`, which converts a user name to `uid` and `gid` values. The file contains only function declarations and include guards, so it serves as an interface for platform-specific system utility code.
